The SAP BDC Datasphere Data Lake Consultant will be responsible for designing building and operating modern enterprise data platforms using SAP Business Data Cloud BDC, SAP Datasphere, SAP BTP and hyperscaler data lakes

The role focuses on SAP and non-SAP data integration semantic modeling governance analytics enablement and cloud first data architecture for S4HANA and RISE programs

Key Responsibilities

  • SAP Business Data Cloud Datasphere
  • Design and implement SAP Business Data Cloud BDC and SAP Datasphere solutions as the enterprise data foundation
  • Build Spaces semantic models SQL views analytical views cubes and consumption models
  • Develop and manage Replication Flows Data Flows Task Chains and scheduling
  • Implement row level security DAC role based access control and data governance policies
  • Data Integration Data Lake
  • Integrate data from SAP S4HANA ECC BW SuccessFactors Ariba and non SAP systems
  • Design outbound integrations from SAP BDCDatasphere to Azure Data Lake AWS S3 Google BigQuery Databricks Snowflake
  • Configure SAP Cloud Connector DP Agent live and batch data connections
  • Ensure data quality harmonization lineage and traceability across platforms
  • Architecture Data Modeling
  • Define end to end data architecture for SAP analytics landscapes involving BDC Datasphere SAC and external data platforms
  • Design reusable scalable enterprise semantic layers for reporting and AIML readiness
  • Apply best practices in OLAP dimensional modeling and cloud data warehouse design
  • Analytics Enablement
  • Enable analytics consumption using SAP Analytics Cloud SAC live acquired models
  • Support KPI frameworks enterprise dashboards and embedded analytics
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into analytical models
  • Governance Security Operations
  • Implement transport management and lifecycle management across DEVTESTPROD
  • Support DataOps CICD pipelines and automation using SAP BTP CLI or APIs
  • Ensure compliance with SOXGDPR and audit requirements
  • Perform performance tuning monitoring and issue resolution
  • Stakeholder Delivery Management
  • Conduct architecture workshops requirement walkthroughs and design reviews
  • Work closely with SAP functional teams Basis and cloud infrastructure teams
  • Support cutover hypercare and production stabilization activities
  • Contribute to solution documentation standards and knowledge assets

Required Skills Experience

Mandatory Skills

  • Strong hands on experience in SAP Datasphere SAP Business Data Cloud BDC
  • Solid understanding of SAP S4HANA data models CDS Views and ODP extractors
  • Experience with SAP BTP Cloud Connector and integration patterns
  • Strong SQL data modeling and cloud data engineering fundamentals
  • Exposure to SAP Analytics Cloud SAC for analytics and planning scenarios

Good to Have

  • Experience integrating SAP with Databricks Snowflake AzureAWSGCP data lakes
  • Knowledge of ABAP CDS AMDP SQL Script
  • SAP BW BW4HANA DWC migration experience
  • Data governance metadata management and lineage concepts
  • SAP certifications in Datasphere BTP or Analytics

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Clear communication with both business and technical stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently and within cross functional global teams
  • Structured documentation and design orientation

Dear Candidate,

Greetings from Wilco Source a CitiusTech Company!


Position : SAP S/4HANA Functional Consultant

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Hyderabad (4-days from Office)

Work timings: 3pm to 12am IST(Due to US project, based on project need)

Notice Period: Immediate to 30 days

Interview Mode: In-Person Interview


Job Summary:


We are seeking skilled SAP S/4HANA Functional Consultants with experience in SAP implementations, migration projects, and business process transformation initiatives. The ideal candidate should possess strong functional expertise in SAP modules and experience working within Manufacturing or Life Sciences environments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in SAP S/4HANA implementation and transformation projects.
  • Support ECC to S/4HANA migration initiatives.
  • Conduct fit-gap analysis and business process assessments.
  • Design functional solutions aligned with business requirements.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
  • Configure and support SAP business processes across modules.
  • Manage integration points between SAP and third-party applications.
  • Support testing, defect resolution, UAT, and production deployments.
  • Perform root cause analysis and problem management activities.
  • Conduct solution demonstrations, sprint reviews, and business readiness assessments.

Preferred Skills:

  • Manufacturing domain experience
  • Life Sciences domain experience
  • Medical Device Manufacturing
  • Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
  • SAP Commerce Cloud Integration
  • SAP IBP
  • SAP APO
  • Batch Management
  • Serialization
  • GxP Processes
  • Agile Methodology
  • SAFe Framework

Preferred Certifications

  • SAP S/4HANA Professional Certification

Desired Candidate Profile

  • 3 to 6 years of relevant SAP Functional experience.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience working in Agile project environments.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within global teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

Energy Reviews by Employees"},"jobDescription":"

The Opportunity


Join Hitachi Energy's Controlling Capability Center and play a key role in connecting Finance, Business Controllers, and the SAP CO Center of Excellence (CoE). In this role, you will support global finance teams by understanding business requirements, driving process improvements, and ensuring successful delivery of SAP Controlling solutions within the S/4HANA environment.


You will act as a functional partner to controllers and business stakeholders, helping translate business needs into system solutions while working closely with the SAP CO CoE. The role requires strong knowledge of management accounting processes, end-to-end value flows, and SAP Controlling capabilities across manufacturing, project, service, and software business models.


How You'll Make an Impact


Business Partnering & Demand Management


  • Act as a key interface between Controllers, Business Stakeholders, and the SAP CO CoE.
  • Understand and document business requirements related to Controlling processes.
  • Coordinate with SAP CO consultants to evaluate, prioritize, and implement business demands.
  • Track enhancement requests and ensure timely closure of agreed actions.
  • Support global finance teams in resolving process and system-related issues.
  • Drive for the New development from Design to implementation stages
  • Lead Global trainings and awareness sessions to the controlling community across Hitachi Energy.

SAP CO Process Support


  • Support and improve SAP Controlling processes across Archetypes:
  • Make-to-Stock (MTS)
  • Make-to-Order (MTO)
  • Engineer-to-Order (ETO)
  • Services (I2R)
  • Software business models
  • Analyse end-to-end financial value flows and identify process improvement opportunities.

Functional Expertise


Support activities related to:

  • Result Analysis (RA)
  • RAR (Revenue Accounting & Reporting)
  • Material Ledger
  • Standard Costing / Product Costing
  • Cost Object Controlling
  • Profitability Analysis (CO-PA)
  • Costing Sheets
  • Production Variance Analysis
  • Allocation Cycles
  • Assessment & Distribution Cycles
  • CO-PA Assessment Cycles
  • Activity Types and Activity Rates
  • Overhead Rates
  • Profit Center Accounting
  • Inventory Valuation
  • Period-End Closing Activities

Continuous Improvement


  • Identify standardization and automation opportunities.
  • Support global initiatives for process harmonization and simplification.
  • Prepare process documentation, SOPs, training materials, and playbooks.
  • Participate in SAP S/4HANA transformation and enhancement projects.

Compliance & Governance


  • Support adherence to internal controls and financial governance requirements.
  • Ensure process documentation remains updated and audit compliant.
  • Follow Hitachi Energy policies, procedures, and quality standards.

Your Background


Education


  • CA / CMA
  • CA Inter / CMA Inter
  • MBA (Finance)

Experience


  • 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in SAP CO Consultant having strong understanding in Finance, Controlling, Management Accounting and Manufacturing experience.
  • End-to-end implementation experience in SAP CO having strong understanding of CO model along with other integrated models like SD, MM, PS, FI etc.
  • Experience in Manufacturing, Project Business, Industrial, Engineering, or Shared Services environment preferred.
  • Exposure to business partnering, process improvement or ERP transformation initiatives is an advantage.

Key Competencies


  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to interact effectively with Controllers and business stakeholders.
  • Good understanding of Management Accounting and Controlling concepts.
  • Ownership mindset with strong follow-through on deliverables.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work in a global and multicultural environment.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with attention to detail.

We are looking for IT Audit & Technology Risk professionals with strong experience in IT General Controls (ITGC), IT Application Controls (ITAC), and technology risk assessments. This role focuses on strengthening clients technology risk, governance, compliance, and internal control environments through IT audits, control assessments, and code reviews.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform IT General Controls (ITGC) assessments covering:
    • User Access Management
    • Change Management
    • Computer Operations
    • Backup & Recovery
    • Incident & Problem Management
    • Batch Job Scheduling & Monitoring
    • Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery
  • Execute IT Application Controls (ITAC) testing, including:
    • Input Controls
    • Processing Controls
    • Output Controls
    • Interface Controls
    • Data Validation Controls
    • Input Process Output (IPO/IPE) Controls
    • Data Completeness & Accuracy Controls
  • Perform walkthroughs with business and technology stakeholders to understand business processes, system architecture, and control environments.
  • Conduct design and operating effectiveness testing of automated and manual controls.
  • Perform source code reviews to validate application controls, business rules, data processing logic, exception handling, and automated control implementation.
  • Review system configurations and application settings supporting financial and operational processes.
  • Prepare Risk & Control Matrices (RCMs), process flow diagrams, audit workpapers, testing documentation, and audit observations.
  • Identify control gaps, technology risks, and process weaknesses, and provide practical remediation recommendations.
  • Support IT Internal Audits, SOX compliance engagements, Internal Financial Controls (IFC), Technology Risk Assessments, and Risk Advisory engagements.
  • Coordinate with client stakeholders throughout planning, walkthroughs, testing, reporting, and closure activities.

Mandatory Skills

Candidates must have hands-on experience in most of the following areas:

IT Audit & Controls

  • IT General Controls (ITGC / GITC)
  • IT Application Controls (ITAC)
  • IT Internal Audit
  • Technology Risk Assessment
  • Risk & Control Matrix (RCM)
  • Control Design & Operating Effectiveness Testing
  • Business Process Walkthroughs
  • Audit Documentation

ITGC Areas

  • User Access Management
  • Change Management
  • Incident Management
  • Computer Operations
  • Backup Management
  • Batch Job Monitoring
  • Business Continuity
  • Disaster Recovery

ITAC Areas

  • Input Controls
  • Processing Controls
  • Output Controls
  • Interface Controls
  • Data Integrity Controls
  • Data Completeness & Accuracy
  • Input Process Output (IPO/IPE) Controls
  • Automated Controls Testing

Code Review & Technical Knowledge

Candidates should possess the ability to understand application code and validate business logic during audits.

Exposure to one or more of the following technologies is required:

  • Java
  • SQL
  • JavaScript
  • C
  • C++

Development experience is not mandatory; however, candidates should be comfortable interpreting source code during audit engagements.

Preferred Skills

  • SOX 404 Controls Testing
  • Internal Financial Controls (IFC)
  • Information Security Assessments
  • ERP Controls Review
  • SDLC Controls
  • Data Migration Controls
  • Cloud Technology Audits
  • Interface Testing
  • Financial Services Technology Audits

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in ITGC and ITAC assessments, be capable of reviewing application code to validate automated controls, understand enterprise technology environments, possess solid knowledge of SOX and technology risk frameworks, and demonstrate excellent analytical, stakeholder management, communication, and audit documentation skills.

  • Support deployments across Cloud and Hybrid/On-Premise environments and coordinate with infrastructure teams for connectivity, security certificates, and environment setup.
  • Ensure compliance with SAP integration best practices, governance standards, security policies, and organizational development guidelines.

  • Strong experience with SAP Cloud Platform Integration (SAP CPI) / SAP Integration Suite.
  • Hands-on experience with SOAP, REST APIs, OData, IDoc, RFC, XML, JSON, and XSLT.

Qualifications

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Job Summary

At Arctic Wolf, you won't just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve - you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape - but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.

If you re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company s that s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We re looking for a / an IT Enterprise Application Administrator to be part of making this/that happen.

Position Overview and Objective

As the IT Enterprise Application Administrator, you will provide support and expertise in the design, implementation, administration, and support of Microsoft 365 core applications (SharePoint, OneDrive, Email, Purview and Power Platforms), Atlassian (Jira and Confluence), and enterprise AI platforms. You will support existing and future systems while enabling secure, scalable integration across global business environments.

This role focuses on Microsoft 365 core applications administration and design, Microsoft 365 cloud services, and SaaS application integration through APIs and automation. You will work with internal and external teams to implement AI-powered solutions, streamline business processes, and improve employee productivity.

Leveraging your expertise in cloud architecture, enterprise collaboration platforms, AI technologies, and SaaS integrations, you will ensure solutions align with security, compliance, and governance requirements while supporting the organizations digital transformation initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Provide support for enterprise applications, including Microsoft 365 apps, Atlassian (Jira and Confluence), and AI platforms.
  • Design, implement, administer, maintain, and support enterprise collaboration and productivity platforms.
  • Support existing enterprise systems while planning and implementing future technology solutions.
  • Design and maintain secure, scalable integrations between SaaS applications using APIs, automation, and workflow technologies.
  • Implement and support AI-powered tools and solutions to improve business operations and employee productivity.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline and automate business processes through cloud technologies and AI capabilities.
  • Ensure enterprise platforms and integrations meet security, compliance, governance, and regulatory requirements.
  • Troubleshoot, optimize, and provide ongoing support for enterprise applications and integrations.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements that support digital transformation initiatives.
  • Establish and maintain best practices for cloud services, collaboration platforms, AI adoption, and application governance.
  • Participate in on-call rotation.
  • Any other responsibilities assigned by your manager.
  • Ability to travel within US and Internationally.

Experience and Requirements

We re looking for someone with experience in:

  • Associate degree preferred or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field or 2-5 years of experience working in Office 365 and/or cloud related systems.
  • Strong experience with M365 core platform Administration and site design; architecture experience would be nice to have.
  • Experience with scripting (PowerShell, Python or Bash)

Key Focus Areas

  • Enterprise AI Platforms.
  • SaaS Application Integration (APIs & Automation).
  • SharePoint, Power Platform, Purview Data Classification / DLP Administration & Design.
  • Microsoft 365 Cloud Services.
  • Jira & Confluence Administration.
  • Security, Compliance & Governance.
  • Business Process Automation & Productivity Enhancement.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with Enterprise AI Platforms.
  • Strong experience with SaaS Application Integration (APIs & Automation).
  • Experience working with Atlassian cloud stack including JIRA and Confluence administration. Understanding of Jira/Confluence add-ons and integration workflows.
  • Strong experience with scripting (PowerShell, Python or Bash).
  • Strong experience working with M365 core collaboration stack of applications
  • Experience working with agile methodology.
  • Experience working with ServiceNow.

Environment and Physical Demands

  • Work is primarily sedentary in nature and can be executed sitting or standing in positions in an office environment.
  • Requires ability to utilize technology related to using a keyboard, verbal communication, and work with device screens which require visual acuity.
  • If located in a company office, often requires the mobility to physically navigate the space.
  • In the event of business travel, mobility sufficient to utilize public and private transport and navigate to essential locations.
  • May include moving or lifting of 25 pounds or less (e.g., office chair, reams of paper).

Role: SAP Solution Analyst

Location: IBC Knowledge Park, Bangalore

Reporting to: Technincal Architect - SAP Engineering

Team name: Supply Chain Technology



About the Team and the Role


The Supply Chain Technology team at Ather is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting robust digital solutions that optimize core operations, drive end-to-end procurement efficiency, and ensure accurate inventory and logistics management.

This role is for a detail-oriented and experienced SAP MM Functional Consultant to drive the design, configuration, and support of SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement solutions. The role owner will bridge business requirements with technology to streamline the Procure-to-Pay lifecycle and enhance supply chain execution.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end P2P process configuration including Purchase Requisitions, Purchase Orders, RFQs, Outline Agreements, release strategies, and specialized procurement scenarios (subcontracting, consignment, STO).
  • Manage MM master data governance and configuration, covering Material Master, Business Partner (BP), Purchasing Info Records, and Quota arrangements.
  • Configure and oversee Inventory Management processes, special inventory functions (batch management, stock determination), and Physical Inventory cycle counting to ensure stock accuracy.
  • Design Logistics Invoice Verification (LIV), material valuation (standard/moving average price), and automatic account determination for seamless integration with Finance (FI).
  • Translate manufacturing business requirements into detailed RICEFW functional specifications, collaborating with ABAP developers and utilizing BAPI, BADI, and Enhancement Spots.
  • Lead and support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), creating test scripts, resolving defects, and maintaining comprehensive project documentation.
  • Execute data migration activities into SAP S/4HANA utilizing tools such as LTMC and LSMW.
  • Deliver expert production support by troubleshooting and resolving complex issues across system integration points including FI/CO, SD, and PP using IDoc, OData, and ABAP Proxies.

Experience and Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Hands-on experience as an SAP MM Functional Consultant, including participation in at least one full-cycle SAP implementation project
  • 3-5 Years of Relevant experience

Must Have Competencies


  • Expertise in SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement, end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes, and enterprise structure configuration.

The SAP BDC Datasphere Data Lake Consultant will be responsible for designing building and operating modern enterprise data platforms using SAP Business Data Cloud BDC, SAP Datasphere, SAP BTP and hyperscaler data lakes

The role focuses on SAP and non-SAP data integration semantic modeling governance analytics enablement and cloud first data architecture for S4HANA and RISE programs

Key Responsibilities

  • SAP Business Data Cloud Datasphere
  • Design and implement SAP Business Data Cloud BDC and SAP Datasphere solutions as the enterprise data foundation
  • Build Spaces semantic models SQL views analytical views cubes and consumption models
  • Develop and manage Replication Flows Data Flows Task Chains and scheduling
  • Implement row level security DAC role based access control and data governance policies
  • Data Integration Data Lake
  • Integrate data from SAP S4HANA ECC BW SuccessFactors Ariba and non SAP systems
  • Design outbound integrations from SAP BDCDatasphere to Azure Data Lake AWS S3 Google BigQuery Databricks Snowflake
  • Configure SAP Cloud Connector DP Agent live and batch data connections
  • Ensure data quality harmonization lineage and traceability across platforms
  • Architecture Data Modeling
  • Define end to end data architecture for SAP analytics landscapes involving BDC Datasphere SAC and external data platforms
  • Design reusable scalable enterprise semantic layers for reporting and AIML readiness
  • Apply best practices in OLAP dimensional modeling and cloud data warehouse design
  • Analytics Enablement
  • Enable analytics consumption using SAP Analytics Cloud SAC live acquired models
  • Support KPI frameworks enterprise dashboards and embedded analytics
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into analytical models
  • Governance Security Operations
  • Implement transport management and lifecycle management across DEVTESTPROD
  • Support DataOps CICD pipelines and automation using SAP BTP CLI or APIs
  • Ensure compliance with SOXGDPR and audit requirements
  • Perform performance tuning monitoring and issue resolution
  • Stakeholder Delivery Management
  • Conduct architecture workshops requirement walkthroughs and design reviews
  • Work closely with SAP functional teams Basis and cloud infrastructure teams
  • Support cutover hypercare and production stabilization activities
  • Contribute to solution documentation standards and knowledge assets

Required Skills Experience

Mandatory Skills

  • Strong hands on experience in SAP Datasphere SAP Business Data Cloud BDC
  • Solid understanding of SAP S4HANA data models CDS Views and ODP extractors
  • Experience with SAP BTP Cloud Connector and integration patterns
  • Strong SQL data modeling and cloud data engineering fundamentals
  • Exposure to SAP Analytics Cloud SAC for analytics and planning scenarios

Good to Have

  • Experience integrating SAP with Databricks Snowflake AzureAWSGCP data lakes
  • Knowledge of ABAP CDS AMDP SQL Script
  • SAP BW BW4HANA DWC migration experience
  • Data governance metadata management and lineage concepts
  • SAP certifications in Datasphere BTP or Analytics

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Clear communication with both business and technical stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently and within cross functional global teams
  • Structured documentation and design orientation

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. We have a goal of having at least 7% of our workers as people with disabilities. The law says we must measure our progress towards this goal. To do this, we must ask applicants and employees if they have a disability or have ever had one. People can become disabled, so we need to ask this question at least every five years.

Completing this form is voluntary, and we hope that you will choose to do so. Your answer is confidential. No one who makes hiring decisions will see it. Your decision to complete the form and your answer will not harm you in any way. If you want to learn more about the law or this form, visit the U.S. Department of Labor’s Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) website at www.dol.gov/ofccp.","Description2":"How do you know if you have a disability?


A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:


  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)
  • Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS
  • Blind or low vision
  • Cancer (past or present)
  • Cardiovascular or heart disease
  • Celiac disease
  • Cerebral palsy
  • Deaf or serious difficulty hearing
  • Diabetes
  • Disfigurement, for example, disfigurement caused by burns, wounds, accidents, or congenital disorders
  • Epilepsy or other seizure disorder
  • Gastrointestinal disorders, for example, Crohn's Disease, irritable bowel syndrome
  • Intellectual or developmental disability
  • Mental health conditions, for example, depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD
  • Missing limbs or partially missing limbs
  • Mobility impairment, benefiting from the use of a wheelchair, scooter, walker, leg brace(s) and/or other supports
  • Nervous system condition, for example, migraine headaches, Parkinson's disease, multiple sclerosis (MS)
  • Neurodivergence, for example, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism spectrum disorder, dyslexia, dyspraxia, other learning disabilities
  • Partial or complete paralysis (any cause)
  • Pulmonary or respiratory conditions, for example, tuberculosis, asthma, emphysema
  • Short stature (dwarfism)
  • Traumatic brain injury

Because we do business with the government, we must reach out to, hire, and provide equal opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. [1] To help us measure how well we are doing, we are asking you to tell us if you have a disability or if you ever had a disability. Completing this form is voluntary, but we hope that you will choose to fill it out. If you are applying for a job, any answer you give will be kept private and will not be used against you in any way.

If you already work for us, your answer will not be used against you in any way. Because a person may become disabled at any time, we are required to ask all of our employees to update their information every five years.   • Multiple sclerosis (MS)
  • Muscular dystrophy
  • Obsessive compulsive disorder
  • Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD)
  • Schizophrenia
